title: ANCELLM SS26
news: Founded in 2021 by designer Kazuya Yamachika, ANCELLM approaches clothing as a living material, shaped as much by time as by design. Rooted in Japan’s Kojima region, the brand draws from a deep tradition of working with natural fibers, where craftsmanship becomes both process and expression.
